title: TestHeartbeatStopsAtStepEnd fails under -race
lead: `go test -race ./internal/engine` passes, and `TestHeartbeatStopsAtStepEnd` observes the step end under the race detector as it does without it.
findings_note: 2026-11-18 13:55 UTC, main at de74b1d9: `go test -race -count=1 ./internal/engine -run TestHeartbeatStopsAtStepEnd` fails every time with `heartbeat_test.go:129: no stepEnd observed`; the `ok` subtest takes about 60 s. Without -race the same test passes in 1.4 s. Found when S392's Check line `go test -race -count=1 ./...` went red on a diff that does not touch the engine's product code; that line was narrowed in S392.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: A test that fails only under -race either hides a data race or depends on timing the race detector slows down; either way a slice whose Check runs -race over the whole tree goes red for a reason it did not cause (S392, 2026-11-18).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/engine/heartbeat_test.go:95-166` (heartbeatRetryEndSink and TestHeartbeatStopsAtStepEnd)
- `internal/engine/round.go:1247-1293` (stepEnd and heartbeat; read-only reference replacing missing heartbeat.go)
- `landed-changed/S444.md` (entry written by slicer changelog add)

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: - `TestHeartbeatStopsAtStepEnd` in `internal/engine/heartbeat_test.go:114-166` under `go test -race -count=1 ./internal/engine -run TestHeartbeatStopsAtStepEnd`: reproduced before the fix with "no stepEnd observed" at original line 129; passes after the fix, and still passes without -race.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Reproduce under -race and find why the `ok` subtest waits about 60 s and sees no step end (a race, a lock, or a wait the test bounds by wall-clock time).
2. Fix the cause. If it is a real data race in product code, fix the product code; if it is test timing, make the test wait on the event, not on `time.Sleep`.
3. Changelog entry with `slicer changelog add`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- `go test -race ./internal/engine` passes.
- The heartbeat test does not depend on sleep lengths to observe the step end.

Commands:
- `go test -race -count=1 ./internal/engine -run TestHeartbeatStopsAtStepEnd -v`
- `go test -race -count=1 ./internal/engine`
- `go vet ./...`
- `go test ./...`
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch, message "Heartbeat test observes the step end under -race".
